messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: GPU_POOL_SATURATION in region-us-central - autoscaler failing to provision, queue growing.
incident-bot: Severity: P1. Pager routed to @alice (oncall).
alice (oncall): Ack. Looking now. Who has the latest queue snapshot and which customers are impacted?
ben (sre): Snapshot: queued=12,300 (+220/min), avg gen latency 1.9s -> 4.6s, throttle_ratio=0.36. Autoscaler attempts failing with "insufficient quota" when requesting +4 GPUs.
cara (eng-runtime): Confirmed. Autoscaler logs show repeated 403/quota errors: "requested 4 gpus, limit 0" during concurrent warmup + scale ops. Steering service still reports pool healthy (health-check thresholds not tripped).
dmitri (customer-success): Support volume rising. Reports from ACME (chat timeouts) and Fitly (batch embeddings queued). No full outage yet but several elevated customer complaints.
alice (oncall): Mitigation plan: (1) force spill traffic to eu-west1 for non-latency-critical cohorts (2) attempt emergency reserved capacity in us-west dedicated pool (3) throttle dev/free cohorts. Ben, take routing. Cara, coordinate warmup.
ben (sre): I'll force spillover. Note: automatic spillover didn't trigger because steering health threshold is too permissive; I'll override with force flag.
ben (sre): /ops route update --pool primary-us-central --spillover eu-west1 --force
ben (sre): Response: OK. Starting staged shadow to eu-west1.
cara (eng-runtime): Kicking warmup jobs in eu-west1: preloading models + KV cache (warmup job id warmup-1719876543-a). Expect ~90-150s to reach usable cache hit.
eve (product): Product approves temporary spillover for paying customers where availability matters more than small latency delta.
ben (sre): Launching controlled shift: first non-paying cohorts, then expand if metrics look OK.
ben (sre): /ops route shift --from primary-us-central --to eu-west1 --cohort paying=false --pct 100
incident-bot: metric update @1719876600: queued=9,900, eu_warmup=65%
cara (eng-runtime): eu-west1 warmup at 72%, cache hit rising. Small model variant mismatch for v2-quant causing a subtle template difference on a tiny subset; flagged to model-onboarding.
dmitri (customer-success): Drafting customer notice for affected accounts (ACME, Fitly). Sending now.
alice (oncall): Any correctness regressions observed? cara?
cara (eng-runtime): Quick diffs on sample prompts show <2% token divergence for most flows; no safety regressions. Acceptable for short-term spillover.
ben (sre): Opened cloud quota ticket for immediate increase. Meanwhile requested emergency reserved capacity in us-west dedicated pool: /infra reserve --pool region-us-west --gpus 8 --duration 120m
ben (sre): Provider accepted emergency soft-limit override; provisioning proceeding.
incident-bot: metric update @1719876700: queued=3,500, throttle=0.10, eu_traffic=28%
alice (oncall): Good. Keep monitoring. Ben/Cara, owners for rollback and follow-ups?
ben (sre): I'll roll back forced spillover when queue <500 sustained for 15m and eu_traffic stable.
cara (eng-runtime): I'll own post-incident: add warmup backoff to avoid simultaneous quota spikes, increase steering sensitivity for health detection, and add quota headroom metrics and alerts.
dmitri (customer-success): Customer impact: initial spike in tickets but stabilizing. No confirmed SLO breaches yet. Informing account teams for follow-up.
ben (sre): Quick runbook snippet for emergency spillover:
```
1) /ops route update --pool <pool> --spillover <region> --force
2) wait for warmup: /infra warmup status <job_id>
3) /ops route shift --cohort <cohort> --pct 100
4) if provisioning fails: /infra reserve --pool <region> --gpus <n> --duration <m>
```
incident-bot: metric update @1719876823: queued=1,120, throttle=0.06, autoscaler=healthy, incident severity -> P2
alice (oncall): Closing pager -> moving to 2h watch. Postmortem owner: cara (eng-runtime). dmitri to follow up on customer comms. Thread open for watch.
